---
title: "Spontaneous ion binding to the Na+,K+-pump"
description: "Ion access and coordination in atomistic simulations of the Na+,K+-ATPase."
order: 3
---

The trajectory follows ions approaching and occupying sites in the Na+,K+-ATPase, illustrating how atomistic simulations can reveal ion-access pathways and coordination.
